Toddler meals

Baked chicken and carrot loaf

Sült csirkemell zöldséggel

8 months+ Replaced 45 min 6 portions

Slice it soft and offer small pieces. There is no cured meat in the loaf.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 400 g Minced chicken (Raw thigh or breast, not cured meat)
  • 1 medium Carrot (Finely grated)
  • a small handful Fresh parsley (Finely chopped)
  • 1 teaspoon Olive oil (To grease the tin)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Mix the minced chicken, carrot, and parsley.
  3. Press the mix into a small greased tin.
  4. Bake until the centre is opaque and the juices run clear, about 30 minutes.
  5. Rest for five minutes, then slice soft.

Replaced

The usual name is a chicken ham. Shop ham is salty and cured.

Bake an unsalted loaf of minced chicken, grated carrot, and herbs, and slice it soft. No nitrite salt is used.
